cases.source: MongoDB manual, $sort (aggregation) / Behavior: "When sorting on multiple fields, $sort evaluates sort order from left to right" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/sort/)

MongoDB manual, $sort (aggregation) / Arrays: "In an ascending sort, the sort key is the lowest value in the array" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/sort/); oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-05, $sort {a: 1} matched

MongoDB manual, $sort (aggregation) / Arrays: "In a descending sort, the sort key is the highest value in the array" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/sort/); oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-05, $sort {a: -1} matched

MongoDB manual, $project / Path: field paths such as "contact.address.country" address embedded fields (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/project/); $sort sorts on a field path (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/sort/)

MongoDB manual, Aggregation Pipeline: "The documents that a stage outputs are then passed to the next stage" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/aggregation-pipeline/); $skip and $limit semantics (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/skip/)

MongoDB manual, Aggregation Pipeline: stages run in sequence (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/aggregation-pipeline/); $limit (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/limit/)
MongoDB manual, Aggregation Pipeline: the stage sequence decides what each stage sees (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/aggregation-pipeline/)
MongoDB manual, $limit: "$limit takes a positive integer" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/limit/)
MongoDB manual, $skip: "$skip takes a positive integer that specifies the maximum number of documents to skip" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/skip/)

MongoDB manual, $count: "Passes a document to the next stage that contains a count of the number of documents input to the stage" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/count/)

MongoDB manual, $count / Behavior: "If the input dataset is empty, $count doesn't return a result" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/count/); oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-05, $count on an empty collection returned no documents

MongoDB manual, $count: counts "the number of documents input to the stage" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/count/); oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-05, $count after an empty $match returned no documents
MongoDB manual, $count: "<string> must be a non-empty string, must not start with $ and must not contain the . character" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/count/)

MongoDB manual, $unwind / Syntax: "When using this syntax, $unwind does not output a document if the field value is null, missing, or an empty array" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/operator/aggregation/unwind/); oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-05, string form matched

MongoDB manual, $unwind: "If true, if path is missing or is an empty array, $unwind omits the output field ... If the value is null, the field remains null"; "the index is 0 for array inputs and null for non-array inputs" / "When includeArrayIndex is specified and the document is preserved, the index is null" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/operator/aggregation/unwind/); oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-05, matched including includeArrayIndex being int64

MongoDB manual, $unwind: "If false, if path is null, missing, or an empty array, $unwind does not output a document. The default value is false" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/operator/aggregation/unwind/)

MongoDB manual, $unwind: "If the value is not missing, not null, and not an empty array, $unwind outputs a single document using the value as-is" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/operator/aggregation/unwind/); oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-05, scalar value kept as-is and includeArrayIndex is null
MongoDB manual, $unwind / Syntax: the path is given as "$field" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/operator/aggregation/unwind/)
MongoDB manual, $group: the group key may be an expression such as a field path (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/group/)

MongoDB manual, $group: "If you specify an _id value of null, or any other constant value, the $group stage returns a single document that aggregates values across all of the input documents" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/group/); oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-05, _id: null matched
MongoDB manual, $group: "null, or any other constant value" aggregates across all input documents (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/group/)

MongoDB manual, $avg: "$avg ignores non-numeric values, including missing values. If all input values are non-numeric, $avg returns null" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/avg/); $sum ignores non-numeric values (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/operator/aggregation/sum/); $min/$max ignore null and missing values but compare all other values by BSON order, so a string sorts above a number (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/min/); oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-05, matched

MongoDB manual, $avg: all non-numeric returns null (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/avg/); $sum returns 0 when no numeric values remain (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/operator/aggregation/sum/); $min/$max return null only when all values are null or missing (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/min/), so a lone string is returned as-is; oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-05, matched

MongoDB manual, $push: "Returns an array of all values that result from applying an expression to each document in a group" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/push/); $addToSet: "Returns an array of unique values ... The order of elements in the array is unspecified" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/addToSet/)

oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-06, $group with documents v=1, missing, null, 2 returned pushed [1, null, 2]: a missing field is skipped while an explicit null is kept (probe group.push_missing_field); $addToSet skipped the missing field too (probe group.add_to_set_documents)

oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-06, $addToSet over {x:1,y:2}, {y:2,x:1}, [1,2], [2,1], 1, 1.0, "s" and a missing field produced 6 distinct values: embedded documents compare by field order, arrays compare element-wise, numbers compare by value and the missing field is skipped (probe group.add_to_set_documents)

MongoDB manual, $push: "To guarantee a defined order, place a $sort stage before the $group stage" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/push/); $first returns null for a missing field (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/first/); oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-05, sort-before-group ordering matched; the missing-field-null path was not probed
MongoDB manual, $group: "If there are no documents from the prior pipeline stage, the $group stage returns nothing" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/group/)

MongoDB manual, $match: "$match selects the documents ... using the same query syntax as find" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/match/) applied to a $group output (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/group/)

MongoDB manual, $project: "<field>: <1 or true> — Specifies the inclusion of a field"; "To exclude the _id field ... explicitly specify the suppression" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/operator/aggregation/project/)

MongoDB manual, $project: "If you specify the exclusion of a field other than _id, you cannot employ any other $project specification forms"; `_id: 0` is the documented exception (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/operator/aggregation/project/)

MongoDB manual, $project: "if you exclude fields, you cannot also specify the inclusion of fields, reset the value of existing fields, or add new fields" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/operator/aggregation/project/); oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-06, {a:1, b:0} is rejected with code 31254 and errmsg "Invalid $project :: caused by :: Cannot do exclusion on field b in inclusion projection" (probe project.mixing_rejected)

checks.equals: Invalid $project :: caused by :: Cannot do exclusion on field b in inclusion projection

checks.equals: Invalid $project :: caused by :: Cannot do inclusion on field a in exclusion projection

cases.source: oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-06, exclusion-first {b:0, a:{$add:[1,2]}} is rejected with code 31252 and errmsg "Invalid $project :: caused by :: Cannot use expression other than $meta in exclusion projection"

checks.equals: Invalid $project :: caused by :: Cannot use expression other than $meta in exclusion projection

cases.source: oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-06, {_id:1, b:0} is accepted and keeps _id, a and c while dropping b: a boolean/numeric _id rule does not count as a mixing conflict

MongoDB manual, $project: "If you specify an inclusion of a field that does not exist in the document, $project ignores that field inclusion and does not add the field" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/operator/aggregation/project/)

MongoDB manual, $add: "Adds numbers together ... The arguments can be any valid expression as long as they resolve to either all numbers or to numbers and a date" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/add/)

MongoDB manual, $concat: "If the argument resolves to a value of null or refers to a field that is missing, $concat returns null" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/concat/)

MongoDB manual, $ifNull: "The first non-null input expression value found" ... "$ifNull treats undefined values and missing fields as null" (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/ifnull/)
MongoDB manual, Aggregation Pipeline Operators (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/); $toUpper is documented but not implemented here

MongoDB manual, $lookup / Equality Match: localField, foreignField and as (https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/lookup/); oracle: mongod 8.0.9 standalone (--port 28017), 2026-11-06, equality form matched
